desc_zh: 按项目尺寸和画面文件生产 PVC 广告横幅，可选多种边缘与安装加工方式。
desc_en: Custom-printed PVC banners produced to your project dimensions, with a choice of practical finishing options.

detail_zh.lead: 面向贸易订单、活动推广及户外展示的定制 PVC 横幅喷绘成品。提供成品尺寸和画面需求，可按实际安装方式选择后道加工。
highlights: 根据项目需求定制成品尺寸
短边约 5 米无拼接生产能力，须按画面尺寸评估
支持包边、打鸡眼扣、加绳及穿杆袋
可按指定成品尺寸裁切
applications: 围挡、工地及临时宣传展示
delivery: 根据订单核算包装和运费
detail_zh.artwork: 客户可以提供印刷文件。基础文件检查和简单调整可免费提供；较大幅度修改或从零设计需单独报价。
detail_zh.brief: 请提供成品宽度和高度、数量、设计文件、加工位置（如有指定鸡眼间距请注明）、交付形式及目的地。
detail_zh.caveat: 约 5 米无拼接能力并不代表任意长宽组合都能生产。每个画面均需在生产前评估，连续长度和最终包装按订单确认。

detail_en.lead: Made-to-order printed PVC banners for trade projects, events, promotions and outdoor displays. Supply the finished dimensions and artwork brief; finishing can be specified to suit the intended installation.
highlights: Custom dimensions based on your project brief
Approx. 5 m seamless shorter-side capability, subject to artwork dimensions and production assessment
Hemming, eyelets, rope finishing and pole pockets available
Cut to the requested finished size
applications: Fencing, site and temporary campaign displays
delivery: Packing and freight assessed for the order
detail_en.artwork: Print-ready artwork can be supplied by the buyer. Basic file checks and minor adjustments are available at no extra cost; extensive artwork changes or original design work are quoted separately.
detail_en.brief: Please share finished width and height, quantity, artwork, finishing positions (including eyelet spacing if specified), delivery format and destination.
detail_en.caveat: The approximately 5 m seamless capability is not a promise for every width-and-height combination. Each layout is reviewed before production. Continuous lengths and final packing are confirmed against the order.
